955 reviews. 4.4 stars. For an Irish bar on a Vietnamese island.

The Rabbit Hole Irish Bar on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is doing something right. Cold pints, live sport on screen, and a crowd that keeps coming back. Budget $15-30 a head and you're set for the night.

Phu Quoc has beach bars. This one has atmosphere.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
